runtime_policy.product_integrity: Product pixels are preserved from the input cutout. AI may generate background and decoration, but must not redraw the product.
runtime_policy.brand_integrity: EXITE wordmark must be deterministic vector/raster asset, not generated freely by prompt.
runtime_policy.layout_control: Frame, brand shelf, product slot, bottom bar, side panel, and text modules are placed by renderer coordinates.
runtime_policy.open_design_role: Open Design style tools can be used for visual exploration and editable template authoring. Production requires exported layer structure or conversion into FrameKit module specs.
